status: FROZEN SPECIFICATION — not executed; no case currently satisfies its precondition
purpose: quantify the gap between the expectation of realized directional throughput and the directional throughput of the expected net schedule

precondition.requirement: a configuration with more than one market or operation scenario at the shared-ESS-bearing networks
precondition.current_status: SRP1 has NumMarketScenarios = 1 and num_operation_scenarios = 1 for the TSO and all three DSOs, so the discrepancy is identically zero by construction
precondition.rule: DO NOT run this diagnostic on a single-scenario configuration; a zero result there is structural and must never be recorded as a measured null

quantities.A_expectation_of_realized_throughput: sum_{s_m,s_o} pi_m*pi_o * sum_p ( eff_ch * shared_es_pch[e,s_m,s_o,p] * dt + shared_es_pdch[e,s_m,s_o,p] * dt / eff_dch )
quantities.B_throughput_of_expected_schedule: sum_p ( eff_ch * pch_hat[p] * dt + pdch_hat[p] * dt / eff_dch ), where pch_hat/pdch_hat are the ESSO's directional decomposition of expected_shared_ess_p[p] = sum_{s_m,s_o} pi_m*pi_o*shared_es_pnet[e,s_m,s_o,p]
quantities.discrepancy: A - B, reported absolutely, relative to A, and as equivalent full cycles via 2*cl_nom*E_rated
quantities.sign_expectation: A >= B, with equality iff no period has scenarios of opposing dispatch sign; report any violation as a defect in the diagnostic, not a finding

reporting.aggregate: annualized via the same (num_days/365) weighting the production law uses
must_report: number of periods with sign disagreement across scenarios
worst-period discrepancy with its scenario decomposition
resulting SoH difference after the cumulative exponent

controls: recompute B by the production path and require it to match the ESSO's own es_avg_ch_dch_per_unit to machine precision; a mismatch invalidates the diagnostic
run once on a deliberately single-scenario case and require the discrepancy to be exactly zero, as a null control for the implementation
interpretation_limits: this measures a modelling discrepancy, not an error: which of A or B is correct depends on the definitional decision recorded in P5_13_A_THROUGHPUT_DEFINITION.md
no causal or planning-ranking claim may be drawn from it without re-deriving the ranking baseline under the chosen definition

dependencies.blocked_by: the definitional decision (Option A or Option B) and the penalty-classification decision, both of which change the objective
dependencies.implementation_consequence: the coordination/evaluation path hard-wires scenario (0,0) at p56a_oracle.py:275-287 and :393-397, so a multi-scenario case requires changing that path before this diagnostic can run
